title: Norq Infectious Diseases Center staff protest over threatened layoffs or reassignment
organizer: Hospital employees; named organizer not identified
participants_original: “Several dozen” staff, as reported by Radio Azatutyun; exact attendance not stated.
threshold_50_evidence: The opened report says “several dozen” protested. A separate figure of more than 80 refers to employees affected/notified, not those present. Available attendance wording does not establish 50 participants.

start_date.summary: Opened article dated Jan. 10 describes the protest that day.

location.summary: The report identifies the Norq Infectious Diseases Center in Yerevan.

demands.summary: Workers objected to threatened layoffs or transfer during renovation; retained outside the fixed demand taxonomy pending policy characterization.

participants_original.summary: Report wording is “several dozen”; the 80 figure is affected employees, not attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No evidence of at least 50 participants; reported phrase is “several dozen.”

state_response.summary: Report describes the center director meeting protesters and the Ministry stating staff would not be left without work; accommodation is coded yes for the reported meeting, while outcome remains uncertain.

protester_violence.summary: The consulted body did not establish a violence classification.

eligibility.summary: Public protest and state-run center/Ministry involvement are reported, but the threshold is unproven and the precise state-policy demand needs review.

notes: Do not treat the 80 affected employees as demonstrators. Source says protesters returned to work afterward; exact end date is not established. Several follow-up results are blocked or search-only.
open_questions: Can a contemporaneous report establish at least 50 people at the protest?
Was the decision challenged state policy or an employer-specific employment matter?
What was the final employment outcome after Jan. 30?

title: Protest outside Yerevan Zoo over animal deaths and zoo management
organizer: Unknown. Former zoo employee Anush Rafayelyan spoke; the report does not identify the protest organizer.
participants_original: Aravot identifies former employee Anush Rafayelyan and two other employees as participating; it says more attendance had been expected but many avoided it after the zoo management council statement. Total attendance is not stated.
threshold_50_evidence: The article specifically identifies three participants and says larger attendance had been planned but many stayed away. It provides no total count and no evidence that 50 attended.

start_date.summary: Article dated Jan. 31 at 17:30 and describes the protest as occurring today.

location.summary: The article places the protest outside Yerevan Zoo.

organizer.summary: Organizer not named; former employee Anush Rafayelyan is a speaker and attendee.

demands.summary: Grievances focus on zoo directors/management and employee treatment; no direct state-policy demand is stated, so no taxonomy code assigned.

participants_original.summary: Three people are specifically identified; the article says additional attendance had been expected, but many avoided participation. Total crowd unknown.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No total count; source names only three and says many intended participants avoided the action.

state_response.summary: Zoo management council statement was issued before the event; the article does not establish an action by state authorities in response to the protest.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence is described; absent information remains unknown.

eligibility.summary: Occurrence, date and location supported; threshold of 50 and state-policy target remain unproven.

notes: Opened Aravot body reports grievances about zoo management, animal deaths and employee treatment. Claims about animal deaths, management conduct, psychological pressure and salary deductions are attributed to speakers, not independently verified. A speaker said city hall knew about the situation, but no clear demand to state policy is established. The zoo council statement preceded the protest; no post-action response is established.
open_questions: Did organizers direct a demand to municipal/state policy, rather than zoo management/employer?
Is the separate municipality action in search result S021 a distinct event?

title: Drivers protest rising compulsory motor insurance premiums in Yerevan
organizer: Group of citizens/drivers; organizers not identified.
participants_original: Armenpress says seven people from the ongoing action were taken to the police station. This is a detention count, not total attendance.
threshold_50_evidence: No crowd estimate. Seven detained is not total turnout and does not establish 50 participants.

start_date.summary: Armenpress article timestamped Jan. 31, 15:35, and says the action was ongoing.

organizer.summary: Article describes a group of citizens; it does not identify organizers.

demands.summary: Participants demanded revision of the compulsory motor-insurance price decision.

participants_original.summary: Police reported seven persons taken to the police station; this is not the number of protesters.

state_response.summary: Police said seven persons were taken to the station; recorded as arrests/detention reported, without claiming legal status.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence described; absent information remains unknown.

eligibility.summary: Event and price-change demand are confirmed; state-policy nexus and 50-person threshold remain unresolved.

notes: Armenpress confirms the Republic Square action and that participants demanded revision of the premium increase decision. It attributes the rate decision to the Auto Insurers’ Bureau; the article alone does not establish a state-policy target. Police statement says seven persons were taken to the station; legal status is not specified. No end time or protester violence evidence.
open_questions: Was the demand directed to government regulation or the Auto Insurers’ Bureau?
Was any other reported Central Bank/taxi action the same event or separate?
